script_text: This week Venus squares Jupiter and your quiet life gets a very loud invitation. Mercury is direct in Gemini on the 24th, firing up your 12th House mind and clearing foggy decisions. The Sun sextiles Saturn in Pisces midweek, giving you steady power to lock in a long-term commitment. Wednesday Venus enters your 4th House, pulling your focus home and into family matters. By Friday Mars in Leo squares your Sun in the 12th, stirring restless doubts about your deeper path. Weekend sees you leaning into creative risk. Thursday is your power day because Jupiter enters your 5th House, opening a flirtation you won't see coming. Saturday is rough — Venus squares Jupiter again, tempting overspending. Mercury, your ruling planet, is your ally all week if you write things down. Pause before signing contracts this week. Follow for daily updates.
